title: Compare Rates of Change Review Test
description: Compare rates of change across proportional relationships, tables, graphs, and contexts.

questions.questionText: Plan A changes by 6 units for every 2 steps. Plan B changes by 10 units for every 4 steps. Which statement is true?
options: Plan A has the greater rate
Plan B has the greater rate
The rates are equal
The rates cannot be compared
questions.correctAnswer: Plan A has the greater rate
questions.explanation: Compare each unit rate by dividing output change by input change.
